about: Machine-readable register of anet 0.3.0 wire keys, labels, relayauth actions, reason codes, hub API and control fields, metadata keys and events. Frozen with the 0.3.0 core design: any change goes in one commit together with the design and the affected golden vectors. Checked by wire/registry_test.go and, against the code of each repository, by wire/scan; docs/wire-keys.md is generated from it by wire/gen.

versions.value: ANetCore v0.16.0; anet 0.3.0; ANetHub 0.3.0; ANetLink 0.2.0 (C1 v1)
v = 2: key 7 access required, key 8 exp optional
Wrap (with or without a second layer)
adds 11 notice, 14 grant, 15 rk; 21 retired; 10 and 12 conditional; preimage v2
anet.enckeys/2: <= 32 keys, each <= 2 days, key 5 mbox required
KEL v2: key 0 anet.kel/2; icp, rot, dip only; keys 9, 11, 12; every identity re-incepted
preimage anet-relay/v2/ unchanged; the action set of relayauth.actions; replay rule RC1
v: 3: adds dack, addr; removes not_delivered, reach, reachable
anet-relay/v2 binding; anet-p2p/v1 and anet-pricing/v1 removed; anet-price/v1 (extended card only), anet-preview/v1
evidence v2; supply chain v2 (anet.supply.epoch, ael VersionMajor2); vouchers removed
PRAGMA user_version = 3 (interactions.db, hub.db); enc_keys.cbor v = 2; removed config.json keys refuse to start

objects.name: SealedEnvelope
objects.desc: Outer sealed envelope v2, the only part a hub sees. Keys 0-63 must be understood; >= 64 are kept and digested.

keys.name: v
keys.note: outer version; anything but 2 is bad-version

keys.name: suite
keys.note: 1 = DHKEM-X25519 / HKDF-SHA256 / ChaCha20-Poly1305; 2 reserved for a post-quantum suite

keys.name: kid
keys.note: kid of one of the recipient's encryption epoch keys; never an interaction key

keys.name: ct
keys.note: layer-1 ciphertext; the plaintext is Wrap

keys.name: access
keys.note: delivery credential; outside the HPKE info, the inner signature and env_digest

keys.name: exp
keys.note: expiry of a one-shot envelope; when present it equals inner key 8 (else exp-mismatch); queued envelopes never carry it

keys.name: kind
keys.note: 0 = first-contact session; 1 = capability; 2 reserved for an anonymous first-contact token (refused in 0.3.0)

keys.name: proof
keys.note: proof of possession, Ed25519 by the holder key (L5)

objects.name: Cap
objects.desc: Capability as carried on the wire.

keys.name: sig
keys.note: Ed25519 over body by the mailbox signing key

objects.name: CapBody
objects.desc: Signed body of a capability issued by the recipient.

keys.name: owner
keys.note: issuer AID; must equal outer to

keys.name: epoch
keys.note: must equal the owner's current mbox.epoch (>= 1)

keys.name: cap_exp
keys.note: expiry; accepted window now - 5 min <= cap_exp <= now + 31 days

keys.name: holder
keys.note: holder Ed25519 public key, new for every capability

objects.name: Wrap
objects.desc: Layer-1 plaintext. Unknown keys 0-63 are bad-wrap; >= 64 are ignored.

keys.name: ikid
keys.cond: present exactly when there is a second layer, together with key 2

keys.name: body
keys.note: layer-2 ciphertext, or coredet(SealedInner) when there is no second layer

keys.name: pad
keys.note: all-zero Padme padding: len(coredet(Wrap)) falls on a Padme step

objects.name: SealedInner
objects.desc: Inner signed message v2 (no version field; it takes effect with outer v = 2).

keys.name: to
keys.note: must equal outer to; no U+0000

keys.name: mid
keys.note: message id; (from, mid) is the replay key

keys.name: body
keys.note: body; the signature preimage holds its SHA-256

keys.name: kel
keys.cond: forbidden in preview frames, required in every other type

keys.name: notice
keys.note: witness notices; exactly one in 0.3.0; each <= 1024 bytes

keys.name: keys
keys.cond: forbidden in preview frames, required in every other type

keys.note: proposed once for a witness KEL; not adopted

keys.name: grant
keys.note: forbidden in preview frames, after-the-fact refusal notices and anet.card/1

keys.name: rk
keys.cond: while the sender still holds its interaction key for this interaction

keys.name: sig
keys.note: Ed25519 over the v2 signature preimage (L3)
preimage only (enc1, kid, suite, ikid, enc2)

objects.name: Grant
objects.desc: Capability handed to the recipient inside the sealed message (inner key 14).

keys.name: home
keys.note: issuer's hub AID (a routing hint, not a URL)

keys.name: ix
keys.note: present: a one-shot capability for this interaction only; must equal inner ix

keys.name: p2p
keys.note: issuer's direct address host:port; only with class = 1 and no key 4

keys.name: pay
keys.note: true: the issuer prices a capability; only without key 4

objects.name: InnerSigPreimage
objects.desc: Signature preimage v2 M: the inner fields except 20 as received, key 9 replaced by coredet(bstr(SHA-256(body))), plus keys 0 and 30-34. Built, never decoded.

keys.name: ikid
keys.note: Wrap key 1, CBOR null for a single layer

keys.name: enc2
keys.note: Wrap key 2, CBOR null for a single layer

objects.name: HPKEInfo
objects.desc: HPKE info map of layer 1 (L1) and layer 2 (L2). Built, never decoded.

keys.note: the KEL travels only in inner key 10

keys.name: interaction_id
keys.note: must equal inner ix; no U+0000

objects.name: Attachment
objects.desc: A file attached to a delegation or message.

objects.name: ChatMsg
objects.desc: Body of anet.message/1. Keys 4-7 and 11-13 only in kind = stream_preview (else bad-body).

keys.name: kind
keys.note: text, end_request, cancel, stream_preview; end_accept retired

keys.name: body
keys.note: in a preview frame the tail window, <= 8192 bytes

keys.name: msg_id
keys.cond: required in preview frames, optional otherwise

keys.name: status
keys.note: done or failed (queued never on the wire)

keys.name: reply
keys.cond: text task with status = done: optional; capability task: forbidden

objects.name: ReplyMsg
objects.desc: The reply folded into a text task's result: a subset of ChatMsg; any other key is bad-body.

objects.name: CardGet
objects.desc: Body of anet.card.get/1: the empty map (the type string carries the version).

objects.name: CardResp
objects.desc: Body of anet.card/1: exactly one of the two keys.

keys.name: card
keys.note: the provider-signed extended card bytes, <= 64 KiB

keys.name: seq
keys.note: publication sequence, unix-ms scale; the hub's prev_seq compare-and-swap uses it

objects.name: EncKey
objects.desc: One encryption key; not_after - not_before <= 2 days.

objects.name: Mbox
objects.desc: Mailbox signing key in a key set.

objects.name: SignedEncKeySet
objects.desc: A key set and the identity signature over it.

keys.name: key_state_seq
keys.note: must be the active tip of the KEL

objects.name: KeyEvent
objects.desc: KEL v2 event. AID = CID(icp preimage); the icp preimage and stored form carry no key 1.

keys.name: t_obj
keys.note: v2 marker and domain separation; a missing or wrong key 0 makes the KEL unreplayable

keys.name: aid
keys.cond: absent in the icp preimage, required otherwise

keys.name: keys
keys.note: exactly one 32-byte key: k0 for icp, the revealed key for rot and dip

keys.name: next
keys.cond: icp and rot; forbidden in dip
keys.note: SHA-256 of the next public key

keys.name: witnesses
keys.cond: icp and rot may carry it; forbidden in dip

keys.name: toad
keys.cond: icp and rot, written even when 0; forbidden in dip
keys.note: 0 for a hub, 1 for an agent

objects.name: SignedEvent
objects.desc: A KEL event with its signature. The raw event bytes must equal coredet(decoded event).

keys.name: aid
keys.note: the AID the notice is about

keys.name: seq
keys.note: tip seq of the KEL the witness holds

objects.name: IdentityFile
objects.desc: identity.kel in the data directory (also the hub identity file), 0600.

keys.name: cur
keys.cond: absent while a recover is waiting to publish

keys.name: hot_next
keys.cond: only while the KEL has one event
keys.note: hot key seed committed by icp

keys.name: state
keys.note: ok, stopped or deactivated; anything else is refused

keys.name: local_commit
keys.note: next_digest derived from the RS of the unprotected recovery file when joined without a terminal; written once, never deleted; public

objects.name: IdentityPending
objects.desc: An identity event being built or published (IdentityFile key 4).

keys.name: revealed
keys.note: seed of the key this event reveals

objects.name: WitnessPush
objects.desc: A witness the identity still has to push to (IdentityFile key 5).

objects.name: RecoveryBlob
objects.desc: The base64 block of a recovery file. aad = coredet(RecoveryBlob without key 7).

keys.name: kdf
keys.note: exactly one of two shapes: passphrase (argon2id) or local (unprotected file)

keys.name: hub
keys.note: witness hub URL at creation (a hint)

keys.name: commits
keys.note: [seq, next_digest] this RS commits to; public

objects.name: RecoveryKDF
objects.desc: Key derivation of a recovery file (RecoveryBlob key 2).

shapes.when: alg = local: unprotected recovery file, AEAD key = the 32 bytes of recovery_local.key

objects.name: DirEntry
objects.desc: Plaintext of a directory box. An entry with an unknown key, or one that does not open, is skipped.

objects.name: ReviewAttBody
objects.desc: Hub attestation of a stored review.

objects.name: LiabLeafContent
objects.desc: Content of a liability tree leaf (hashed under L25).

objects.name: aobj.Envelope
objects.desc: Detached signature envelope of signed objects (unchanged since 0.2.1).

objects.name: PaymentAuthorization
objects.desc: x402 anet-credit payment authorization (signed preimage; unchanged). Key 8 is PayBind.

objects.name: AELRecord
objects.desc: Evidence event log record (unchanged; the supply epoch record uses version_major 2).

objects.name: AELHeadAttestation
objects.desc: Witness attestation of an ael chain head (signed preimage; unchanged).

objects.name: A2ACardJWS
objects.desc: The JWS signing input of an A2A agent card signature (A2A §8.4, RFC 7515 §5.1): ASCII(BASE64URL(protected header)) '.' BASE64URL(RFC 8785 form of the card without signatures). Not a CBOR map, so it has no keys; it starts with eyJ, which no CBOR map and no text preimage does (core §3.4). Signed under kid did:anet:<AID>#<seq> by the identity's current key (a2acard.SignWithSnapshot); its vectors are the a2a-python ones (CORE-G3).

objects.name: Effect
objects.desc: Result of a capability invocation in the kernel (unchanged).

objects.name: CapList
objects.desc: C1 v1: capabilities the adapter serves.

keys.name: id
keys.note: <cap>@<adapter>/<device>; the daemon does not parse it

objects.name: Caller
objects.desc: C1 v1 caller, verified by the daemon.

keys.name: aid
keys.cond: required when via = 1; forbidden when via = 0

keys.note: kept for a later non-witness mode

objects.name: InvokeResp
objects.desc: C1 v1 invoke answer (fields as in v0).

objects.name: TaskDoc
objects.desc: Task document (unchanged). Its signature is a detached aobj envelope over TaskDocPreimage.

objects.name: TaskDocPreimage
objects.desc: The part of a TaskDoc the signature covers.

objects.name: Context
objects.desc: Task context entry (anet's keys: see taskdoc_contexts).

objects.name: EncKeyFile
objects.desc: enc_keys.cbor v2 in the data directory, 0600; a v other than 2 refuses to start.

keys.name: last_seq
keys.note: largest key-set seq this ring signed

keys.name: last_wall
keys.note: local wall clock at the last maintenance

keys.name: unverified_run
keys.note: run time with the hub gate closed; 0 when open or without a hub

objects.name: RingKey
objects.desc: One key of the epoch key ring.

keys.name: removed_at
keys.note: 0 while still in the hub's registered set

keys.name: prev_at
keys.note: at of the previous mark; 0 = none

keys.name: silent
keys.note: a silent adoption: not shown, no evidence

objects.name: OrgGenesis
objects.desc: Organization genesis; not signed, its CID is the org_id (L41).

objects.name: CogUnitBody
objects.desc: Blackboard cognitive unit body; its CID is the unit id.

objects.name: CogUnitWire
objects.desc: Cognitive unit on the wire (the envelope moved from key 8 of the same map into a bstr-carried body).

tags.build: layer-1 HPKE info = coredet({1: "anet-seal/v2", 2: to, 3: suite, 4: kid}); aad empty
layer-2 HPKE info = coredet({1: "anet-ix/v2", 2: to, 3: suite2, 4: ikid}); aad empty
inner signature preimage v2 (InnerSigPreimage)
env_digest = SHA-256("anet-env/v2" || 0x00 || coredet(outer field map without key 7)), field values as received
proof = Ed25519(holder_sk, "anet-access/v2" || 0x00 || cap_id(16) || env_digest(32))
Cap.sig = Ed25519(mbox_sk, coredet(CapBody))
session key delivery: HPKE base, suite 1, pkR = epk, info = "anet-sess-key/v1" || 0x00 || hubAID || 0x00 || sid(16); aad empty; plaintext k_sess(32)
MAC = HMAC-SHA256(k_sess, "anet-sess-mac/v1" || 0x00 || sid(16) || 0x00 || ts(decimal) || 0x00 || method || 0x00 || pathAndQuery || 0x00 || X-ANet-Home or empty || 0x00 || SHA-256(body))
h = SHA-256("anet-dir-hash/v1" || 0x00 || UTF-8(aid))
K = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = UTF-8(aid), salt = empty, info = "anet-dir-box/v1", L = 32); box = nonce(12) || ChaCha20-Poly1305(K, nonce, aad = h, pt = coredet(DirEntry))
ack_key = HPKE.Export(layer-1 context, exporter_context = "anet-dack/v1", L = 32)
handle = HMAC-SHA256(ack_key, "anet-dack-handle/v1")[0:16]
tok(o) = HMAC-SHA256(ack_key, "anet-dack-tok/v1" || u8(o))[0:16]
note_key = HMAC-SHA256(ack_key, "anet-dack-note/v1"); the note AEAD aad is tok(o)
KID = SHA-256("anet-enc-kid/v1" || u8(suite) || pub)[0:16] (no 0x00; epoch and interaction keys alike)
SignedEncKeySet.sig = Ed25519(identity key, coredet(EncKeySet))
SignedEvent.sig = Ed25519(k, coredet(KeyEvent)); icp by k0, rot and dip by the key the event reveals
aobj envelope signature over coredet(NoticeBody)
seed(aid, seq) = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = RS, salt = "anet-kel-next/v1", info = UTF-8(aid) || 0x00 || u64be(seq), L = 32)

ct = XChaCha20-Poly1305(key, nonce, RS, aad = coredet(RecoveryBlob without key 7)); key = argon2id(NFC(passphrase), salt, t = 3, m = 64 MiB, p = 4, 32) when kdf = argon2id, or the 32 bytes of recovery_local.key when kdf = {1: "local"}; kdf is inside the aad, so neither mode passes for the other
local file type tags; not signed
"anet-relay/v2/" + action + "/" + aid + "/" + hubAID + "/" + decimal(ts) + "/" + base64url(SHA-256(method || 0x00 || pathAndQuery || 0x00 || body)); agents and peer hubs alike
pow_hash = SHA-256("anet-regpow/v1" || 0x00 || hub_aid || 0x00 || aid || 0x00 || seed(32) || nonce(<= 32)); >= 22 leading zero bits
seed = HMAC-SHA256(pow_key, "anet-regpow-seed/v1" || u64be(floor(ms / 3 600 000)))
leaf = SHA-256("anet-liab-leaf/v1" || 0x00 || salt(32) || coredet(LiabLeafContent))
node = SHA-256("anet-liab-node/v1" || 0x00 || L.h || u64be(L.sum) || R.h || u64be(R.sum))
ix_commit = SHA-256("anet-receipt-ix/v2" || 0x00 || ix || 0x00 || anet.nonce); neither holds U+0000
requester_commit = SHA-256("anet-receipt-requester/v2" || 0x00 || requester_aid || 0x00 || rsalt(32))
provider aobj envelope signature over coredet(ReceiptBody)
ReviewWire.sig = Ed25519(review_sk, coredet(ReviewBody))
tag = HMAC-SHA256(hub_tag_key, "anet-review-tag/v1" || 0x00 || reviewer_aid || 0x00 || subject_aid)[0:16]
hub aobj envelope signature over coredet(ReviewAttBody)
h = SHA-256("anet-settle-guard/v1" || 0x00 || payer || 0x00 || pay_bind) (hub local)
PayBind = hex(SHA-256("anet/x402-bind/v1" || 0x00 || ix || 0x00 || taskNonce)); an ix or taskNonce holding 0x00 is an error
local encrypted field: 0x01 || nonce(12) || AES-256-GCM(aead_key, nonce, plaintext, aad = coredet({1: "anet-local/v1", 2: ix, 3: "<table>.<column>"}))
aead_key = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = ix_dek, salt = empty, info = "anet-local-aead/v1", L = 32); mac_key = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = ix_dek, salt = empty, info = "anet-local-mac/v1", L = 32)
client_key = SHA-256("anet-client-key/v1" || 0x00 || messageId)

client_digest = HMAC-SHA256(mac_key, "anet-client-msg/v1" || 0x00 || canon(normalized content)); canon: members sorted (RFC 8785 3.2.3), strings escaped (3.2.2.2), no whitespace, numbers kept as the client wrote them
inner type (key 4); not a signing label; inside the signature preimage
unchanged
org_id = CID(coredet(OrgGenesis)); not signed
SignedCredential.env signs coredet(OrgCredBody)
CogUnitWire.env signs coredet(CogUnitBody)
